cl. 4. P. (Dhātup. xxvi, 124; cf. यूप) युप्यति (only in pf. युयो॑प; Gr. also aor. अयुपत्; fut. योपिता, योपिष्यति),
to debar, obstruct, disturb, trouble, confuse, efface, remove, destroy, RV.; AV.;
to be effaced or concealed, RV. i, 104, 4 :
Caus. योप॑यति (aor. अयूयुपत्), to efface, obliterate, conceal, remove, destroy, RV.; TS.; Br. :
Intens. योयुप्य॑ते, to make level, smooth, TS.; ŚBr.
effaced, removed, AV.
confused, troubled (cf. अ॑-युपित).

(prob. fr. √ युप्; but according to Uṇ. iii, 27, fr. √ 2. यु) a post, beam, pillar, (esp.) a smooth post or stake to which the sacrificial victim is fastened, any sacrificial post or stake (usually made of bamboos or Khadira wood; in R. i, 13, 24; 25, where the horse sacrifice is described, 21 of these posts are set up, 6 made of Bilva, 6 of Khadira, 6 of Palāśa, one of Uḍumbara, one of Śleṣmātaka, and one of Deva-dāru), RV. &c. &c.
a column erected in honour of victory, a trophy (= जय-स्तम्भ), L.
N. of a partic. conjunction of the class Ākṛti-yoga (i.e. when all the planets are situated in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th houses), VarBṛS.
यूप—कटक m. a wooden ring at the top of a sacrificial post (or an iron ring at its base), L.
यूप—कर्ण m. the part of a s˚ post which is sprinkled with ghee, L.
यूप—केतु m. N. of Bhūri-śravas, MBh.
यूप—केशिन् m. N. of a demon, MānGṛ.
यूप—च्छेदन n. the cutting of a s˚ p˚, KātyŚr.
यूप—दारु n. the wood for a s˚ p˚, Pāṇ. i, 2, 43, Sch.
यूप—द्रु and यूप—द्रुम, m. Acacia Catechu, L.
यूप—द्रु and यूप—द्रुम, m. Acacia Catechu, L.
यूप—ध्वज m. ‘having the s˚ p˚ as an emblem’, N. of the Sacrifice (personified), Hariv.
यूप—मध्य n. the middle part of the s˚ p˚, L.
यूप—मूर्ध m. the head or top of a s˚ p˚, MānŚr.
यूप—लक्षण n. N. of the 1st Pariśiṣṭa of Kātyāyana.
यूप—लक्ष्य m. a bird, L.
यूप—वत् mfn. having a s˚ p˚, Ragh.
यूप—वासस् n. a garment hanging on a s˚ p˚, Vaitān.
यूप—वाह॑ mfn. carrying or bearing a s˚ p˚, RV.
यूप—वेष्टन n. the winding of a covering round a s˚ p˚, KātyŚr.
the pieces of cloth used for covering a s˚ p˚, ib.
यूप—व्रस्क॑ mfn. cutting the s˚ p˚, RV.
यूप—शकल॑ m. a splinter from a s˚ p˚, ŚBr.
यूप—संस्कार m. the consecration of a s˚ p˚, L.
or यूपाख्य, m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
or यूपाख्य, m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
the top of a s˚ post, L.
anything belonging to a s˚ p˚, Jaim.
the pit in which a s˚ p˚ is fixed, ŚrS.
यूपाव˚ट्य m. (scil. शङ्कु), KātyŚr.
an oblation at the erection of a s˚ p˚, ŚrS.
a collection of eleven s˚ p˚, ŚBr.
the ceremony of erecting a s˚ p˚, MBh.
having sacrificial posts and mortars (for pounding), MBh.
= यूप (mc., esp. ifc.), Nyāyam.
a species of wood, L.
यूपक—वत् mfn. having a sacrificial post, ĀśvŚr., Sch.
यूपी-√ 1. कृ P. -करोति, to make into a sacrificial post, Nyāyam., Sch.
(Nyāyam., Sch.) or यूप्य (ŚāṅkhBr.) mfn. fit or suitable for a sacrificial post.
